summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration-5 HIGH verdict race at 390x844, on 2 AI Rival duels started from invite, then 'Play an AI Rival now'. Fixed. Normal-paced run: 9 of 9 tapped cards each showed their own verdict (RIGHT +1 or WRONG) on the same card for about 970-1040 ms, then advanced. No card ever showed a stale verdict, sampled every 60 ms in the browser. The final score of 4 matched the 4 RIGHT verdicts. Rapid run (tapping the moment a new card renders): verdicts were still tied to their card. Timeout: the card showed MISSED for about 500 ms, then advanced, and the next card's timer ran (19 to 17 s, and the ring counted down after the timeout). Countdown sequence: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, PLAY. 6 never appeared. Duel record: the hub shows 'last 10: 0W 0T 10L' and GET /api/rf/duels returns only PvP duels (opponent Player ··0002). The record did not change after forfeiting an AI Rival duel. No deprecated Expo packages were detected in duel.tsx.

minor.issue: The bot score is capped at me.score - 1, so the AI Rival can never win or tie unless the human scores 0 or forfeits. This may be intentional for encouragement, but it makes the rival feel scripted, since the lead banner always says 'You lead by 1'. Product decision.

ui_bugs.component: Duel play: first frame of a new card
ui_bugs.issue: For one render after idx advances, choice is still set until the card-change useEffect resets it, so the options are disabled. A tap in that single frame (about 16-40 ms) is dropped. The rapid-tap script hit this once. Real users will almost never notice. Optional fix: reset choice/fb in the same setState as setIdx, or use useLayoutEffect.

action_items: LOW (optional): Reset choice and fb together with the idx advance (in the setTimeout callback in send()) so the new card is never briefly locked.
PRODUCT: Decide whether the AI Rival should be able to win. Currently the bot is capped at the human's score minus 1.
critical_code_review_comments: duel.tsx:112 resync guard (!fb && choice === null && !sending.current) and line 108 (verdict only when fb.index === idx) fix the race correctly.
duels.py:329 GET /duels filters out vs_bot duels.
Dead code remains: waitedS (duel.tsx:163-164) and void tint (line 344).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (verdict per card, no stale verdict, timer runs, countdown clamp, record excludes bots)

rca_of_issue: Iteration-5 race verified fixed: WS push now arrives while choice !== null / sending, so resync is skipped; verdict bound to fb.index.
